method.effect_meaning: positive contributes bad; negative is protective; raw signed shares
method.endpoint_difference: independent full-held mean minus independent empty-held mean
method.endpoint_interval: normal interval with independent full/empty variance contributions
method.endpoint_missingness: endpoint diagnostics refused separately from path coefficients
method.fresh_coalition_sampling: every occurrence and sample has its own replay seed; no cache

method.walk_sampling: uniform Python-shuffled permutation and its reverse per pair

statistical_limits: Intervals condition on one captured factual episode and simulator world.
Forward and reverse walks within a pair are correlated and count as one unit.
Normal intervals are approximate, especially with small pair or endpoint counts.
There is no multiplicity correction across decisions or targets.
Homogeneous observations can yield zero-width intervals without proving certainty.
Requested seeds do not establish independent model draws or hidden-state equality.
Signed shares are neither probabilities nor normalized responsibility percentages.
Independent endpoint discrepancy is a descriptive diagnostic, not a calibrated test.
The positional adapter may invalidate coalitions after changed stopping behavior.
